entities.name: Shams al-Dīn Abū Abd Allāh al-Khalīlī
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shams al-Dīn Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn Muḥammad al-Khalīlī was a Mamluk-era Syrian astronomer who compiled astronomical tables. He worked for most of his life as a muwaqqit at the Umayyad Mosque in Damascus.
